correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier orthogonality reduces the fourth moment to collision energy. The Gold fifth-power derivative on F_{4^m} has four-element F4 cosets; fiberwise four-term Cauchy plus uniform-amplitude convexity gives the sharp coefficient 5-4/q. Equality forces common-phase signs with zero F2 parity on every affine F4-line; a complete induction proves that these and only these are traces of F4-affine quadratic polynomials, yielding dimension m^2+m+1 and 2^(m^2+m) projective signs. The present standalone gold_checker.py directly verifies 66 energy inputs and optimizer examples and incidence ranks/nullities at q=4,16,64,256 and exhausts sign patterns for q=4,16; finite tests are not used as the all-m proof.

value.rationale: Exact sharp all-m stability constant and full nonlinear-phase equality classification for the first four-uniform even-extension Gold power is a natural complete finite-harmonic extremal result. The high-dimensional affine-subfield parity code has exact dimension m^2+m+1 and gives exponentially many projective maximizing sign patterns, including genuinely nonlinear ones for m>=2. This is not a parameter renaming or just an isolated finite computation; the equality structure is motivated by sharpness for complex-weighted inputs.
